title: Sodom and Gomorrah
description: Abraham intercedes for Sodom and asks God to spare the city if there are righteous people there. Two angels come to Lot in Sodom, and the men of the city surround his house. The angels lead Lot, his wife, and his daughters out of the city before God rains down sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah. Lot's wife looks back and becomes a pillar of salt.

versions.title: Sodom and Gomorrah
versions.description: Abraham intercedes for Sodom, but God destroys Sodom and Gomorrah with fire and sulfur. Lot and his daughters are saved, while Lot's wife becomes a pillar of salt.
